turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got four bananas going completely black on the counter. Again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Prime baking bananas. Do you want to bake with them tonight, or peel and freeze them for later?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a bit, my kid needs me. I'll come back to you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you care if we stay in a hotel or would you rather rent an apartment?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Apartment, if it has a kitchen. Eating out every night gets expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: True. But hotels usually have breakfast included.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We can buy croissants. Honestly I just want a balcony.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ha, okay, balcony and kitchen. I'll filter for that.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: And not too far from the train station please, with all our bags.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Go ahead and use my charger, mine's in the drawer anyway.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, are the bananas getting baked, or frozen?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. My dad uses a walking frame now. What can we do together at the weekend?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: There's plenty. Garden centres are flat and usually have a cafe, so they're a great relaxed outing.
